Danil "'''donk'''" Kryshkovets {{born}} is a [[:Category:Russia|Russian]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' player who plays for [[Team Spirit]] as an entry fragger. He is widely considered as one of the best riflers in the world ever since his breakthrough in late 2023, being named the best player of 2024 and the runner-up for the best player in 2025. <ref name="top24"/><ref name="top25"/> In addition, he has won 13 [[HLTV/MVP Awards|HLTV MVP]] awards, including an MVP from a [[Majors|Major Championship]].

In 2024, his rookie year, donk would sweep the [[HLTV/Awards_Show|HLTV Awards]] winning Rookie, Opener, Highlight and Player of the year.

===Records===
*Most [[HLTV/MVP_Awards|HLTV MVP awards]] from a player's first full year of professional play (5).
**Tied with [[ZywOo]].
*Highest achieved rating at a "Big Event": 1.79 ([[Intel Extreme Masters/2024/Katowice|IEM Katowice 2024]]) <ref name="Kato MVP"/>
